### League
- Teams: 99
- Divisions (9): Barry Sanders Division, Payton Manning Division, Dan Marino Division, Tom Brady Division, Joe Montana Division, Walter Payton Division, Lawrence Taylor Division, John Elway Division, Jim Brown Division
- Season: NFL weeks 1–18; regular season ends after week 18
- Head-to-head matchups: yes
- Standings order: victory points, then pts, then h2h
- Victory points: 2 for a win, 1 for a tie, 0 for a loss (weekly points buckets: 3 2 1)
- Each NFL player can be rostered once per division

### Rosters and lineups
- Roster size: 14
- Injured reserve slots: 1
- Taxi squad slots: none
- Roster limits by position: QB up to 3, RB up to 6, WR up to 6, TE up to 6, Def up to 3
- Starters: 1–9 per week — QB 1–2, RB 1–5, WR 1–5, TE 1–5, Def 1
- Partial lineups allowed: no

### Waivers and trades
- Waivers: blind bidding (FAAB), then first-come first-served once bidding closes
- Blind-bid budget: $100 per season
- Minimum bid increment: $0.01
- Conditional bids: not allowed
- Tied bids broken by: sort
- Waiver rounds per run: 4
- Trade offers expire after 3 days by default

### Draft and keepers
- Draft type: live
- Draft player pool: Both
- Time per pick: 1:00 (hours:minutes)
- Keepers: none
- Salaries / contracts: none
